```{r results=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

library('tidyverse')

# the data file uses ';' as delimiter, and for this we use the read_csv2 function
resReviewsData <- read_csv2('yelpRestaurantReviews_sample_s26.csv')
```
```{r}
# Quick look at columns available
glimpse(resReviewsData)
```
#Part 1(a)
```{r}
# Total number of reviews
n_reviews <- nrow(resReviewsData)
cat("Total reviews:", n_reviews, "\n")

# Number of unique restaurants (by business_id if available, else name+city)
n_restaurants <- resReviewsData %>% distinct(business_id) %>% nrow()
cat("Total unique restaurants:", n_restaurants, "\n")

# Distribution of reviews per restaurant
reviews_per_rest <- resReviewsData %>%
  group_by(business_id, name) %>%
  tally(name = "n_reviews") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_reviews))

summary(reviews_per_rest$n_reviews)

# Histogram of reviews per restaurant
ggplot(reviews_per_rest, aes(x = n_reviews)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Reviews per Restaurant (log scale)",
       x = "Number of Reviews (log10)", y = "Number of Restaurants")

# What fraction of restaurants have fewer than 10 reviews?
reviews_per_rest %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(pct_lt10 = round(mean(n_reviews < 10) * 100, 1),
            pct_lt5  = round(mean(n_reviews < 5) * 100, 1),
            median_reviews = median(n_reviews))
```
#Part 1(b)(i) and (ii)
```{r}
review_summary <- resReviewsData %>%
  group_by(business_id, name, city) %>%
  summarise(avgReviewStars = mean(stars),
            n_reviews = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

# Top 25 by average review star rating
top_25 <- review_summary %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avgReviewStars, n = 25) %>%
  arrange(desc(avgReviewStars))

# Bottom 25 by average review star rating
bottom_25 <- review_summary %>%
  slice_min(order_by = avgReviewStars, n = 25) %>%
  arrange(avgReviewStars)

# Print them
print(top_25 %>% select(name, city, avgReviewStars, n_reviews))
print(bottom_25 %>% select(name, city, avgReviewStars, n_reviews))

# Cities represented in top/bottom 25
cat("Cities in top 25:\n")
table(top_25$city)

cat("\nCities in bottom 25:\n")
table(bottom_25$city)

# (b)(ii) Compare number of reviews between top and bottom 25
cat("\nTop 25 - review count summary:\n")
summary(top_25$n_reviews)

cat("\nBottom 25 - review count summary:\n")
summary(bottom_25$n_reviews)

# Boxplot comparison
bind_rows(
  top_25    %>% mutate(group = "Top 25"),
  bottom_25 %>% mutate(group = "Bottom 25")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = n_reviews, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Number of Reviews: Top 25 vs Bottom 25 Restaurants",
       x = "", y = "Number of Reviews") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
#Part 1(b)(iii)
```{r}
inconsistent_restaurants <- resReviewsData %>%
  group_by(business_id, name, city) %>%
  summarise(avgRating = mean(stars),
            sdRating  = sd(stars),
            n_reviews = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(sdRating))

# Top 10 most inconsistent
head(inconsistent_restaurants, 10)

# Scatter plot: avg rating vs sd rating
inconsistent_restaurants %>%
  filter(!is.na(sdRating)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = avgRating, y = sdRating, size = n_reviews)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Rating Inconsistency vs Average Rating",
       x = "Average Star Rating",
       y = "Std Dev of Star Rating",
       size = "# Reviews") +
  theme_minimal()

# Correlation between avg rating and sd rating
cor(inconsistent_restaurants$avgRating,
    inconsistent_restaurants$sdRating, use = "complete.obs")
```

#Part 1(c)
```{r}
# Distribution of star ratings
star_dist <- resReviewsData %>%
  group_by(stars) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))

print(star_dist)

# Bar chart of star distribution
ggplot(star_dist, aes(x = factor(stars), y = n, fill = factor(stars))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Review Star Ratings",
       x = "Star Rating", y = "Number of Reviews") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Assign sentiment label: 1-2 = negative, 4-5 = positive, 3 = excluded
resReviewsData <- resReviewsData %>%
  mutate(sentiment = case_when(
    stars <= 2 ~ "negative",
    stars >= 4 ~ "positive",
    stars == 3 ~ "neutral"
  ))

# Class balance after excluding 3-star reviews
resReviewsData %>%
  filter(sentiment != "neutral") %>%
  group_by(sentiment) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
```
#Part 1(d)
```{r}
library(tidytext)

# Filter to valid postal codes before text analysis
rrData <- resReviewsData %>% filter(str_detect(postal_code, "^[0-9]{1,5}"))
cat("Rows before filter:", nrow(resReviewsData), "\n")
cat("Rows after filter:", nrow(rrData), "\n")

# Tokenize, remove stopwords, remove numbers, filter by length
rrTokens <- rrData %>%
  select(review_id, stars, text) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(word, "[0-9]")) %>%
  filter(str_length(word) >= 3, str_length(word) <= 15)

# Count how many distinct reviews each word appears in
word_doc_freq <- rrTokens %>%
  group_by(word) %>%
  summarise(n_docs = n_distinct(review_id), .groups = "drop")

# Prune: keep words appearing in at least 100 and at most 15000 reviews
pruned_words <- word_doc_freq %>%
  filter(n_docs >= 100, n_docs <= 15000)

cat("Vocabulary size after pruning:", nrow(pruned_words), "\n")

# Filter tokens to pruned vocabulary
rrTokens_pruned <- rrTokens %>%
  inner_join(pruned_words, by = "word")

# Calculate average star rating per word
word_avg_stars <- rrTokens_pruned %>%
  group_by(word) %>%
  summarise(avg_stars = mean(stars),
            n_docs    = n_distinct(review_id),
            .groups   = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_stars))

# Top 25 positive words (highest avg star rating)
top25_positive <- word_avg_stars %>% slice_max(avg_stars, n = 25)
print(top25_positive)

# Top 25 negative words (lowest avg star rating)
top25_negative <- word_avg_stars %>% slice_min(avg_stars, n = 25)
print(top25_negative)

# Two-panel faceted bar chart
bind_rows(
  top25_positive %>% mutate(group = "Top 25 Positive"),
  top25_negative %>% mutate(group = "Top 25 Negative")
) %>%
  mutate(word = reorder_within(word, avg_stars, group)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = word, y = avg_stars, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Top 25 Positive" = "steelblue",
                               "Top 25 Negative" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Top 25 Positive and Negative Words by Average Star Rating",
       x = "", y = "Average Star Rating") +
  theme_minimal()
```
# 2(a): How many terms in the data match each dictionary
Sentiment analysis using the 3 sentiment dictionaries available with tidytext (use library(textdata))
AFINN http://www2.imm.dtu.dk/pubdb/views/publication_details.php?id=6010
bing  https://www.cs.uic.edu/~liub/FBS/sentiment-analysis.html 
nrc http://saifmohammad.com/WebPages/NRC-Emotion-Lexicon.htm
```{r}
library(textdata)
# Bing matches
bing_matches <- rrTokens_pruned %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word")
cat("Distinct words matching Bing:", bing_matches %>% distinct(word) %>% nrow(), "\n")

# NRC matches
nrc_matches <- rrTokens_pruned %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("nrc"), by = "word")
cat("Distinct words matching NRC:", nrc_matches %>% distinct(word) %>% nrow(), "\n")

# AFINN matches
afinn_matches <- rrTokens_pruned %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("afinn"), by = "word")
cat("Distinct words matching AFINN:", afinn_matches %>% distinct(word) %>% nrow(), "\n")
```

# Part3
```{r}
library(tidytext)
library(textstem)
library(textdata)

rrTokens_q3 <- rrData %>%
  select(review_id, stars, text) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(word, "[0-9]")) %>%
  mutate(word = textstem::lemmatize_words(word)) %>%
  filter(str_length(word) >= 3, str_length(word) <= 15) %>%
  group_by(review_id, stars) %>%
  count(word) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(word, review_id, n) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Bing
```{r}
# Bing scores per-review
rrSenti_bing <- rrTokens_q3 %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"), by = "word")

revSenti_bing <- rrSenti_bing %>%
  group_by(review_id, stars) %>%
  summarise(nwords  = n(),
            posSum  = sum(sentiment == "positive"),
            negSum  = sum(sentiment == "negative"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(posProp    = posSum / nwords,
         negProp    = negSum / nwords,
         sentiScore = posProp - negProp)

# Does it track with star ratings?
revSenti_bing %>%
  group_by(stars) %>%
  summarise(avgPos = mean(posProp), avgNeg = mean(negProp),
            avgSentiSc = mean(sentiScore))

# Predict and evaluate (exclude 3-star reviews)
revSenti_bing <- revSenti_bing %>%
  mutate(hiLo     = ifelse(stars <= 2, -1, ifelse(stars >= 4, 1, 0)),
         pred_hiLo = ifelse(sentiScore > 0, 1, -1))

xx_bing <- revSenti_bing %>% filter(hiLo != 0)
cat("--- Bing Confusion Matrix ---\n")
table(actual = xx_bing$hiLo, predicted = xx_bing$pred_hiLo)
cat("Accuracy:", mean(xx_bing$hiLo == xx_bing$pred_hiLo), "\n")
```
# NRC:
```{r}
rrSenti_nrc <- rrTokens_q3 %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("nrc"), by = "word")

revSenti_nrc <- rrSenti_nrc %>%
  mutate(goodBad = ifelse(sentiment %in%
           c("anger", "disgust", "fear", "sadness", "negative"), -1,
         ifelse(sentiment %in%
           c("positive", "joy", "anticipation", "trust"), 1, 0))) %>%
  group_by(review_id, stars) %>%
  summarise(nrcScore = sum(goodBad), .groups = "drop")

revSenti_nrc <- revSenti_nrc %>%
  mutate(hiLo      = ifelse(stars <= 2, -1, ifelse(stars >= 4, 1, 0)),
         pred_hiLo = ifelse(nrcScore > 0, 1, -1))

xx_nrc <- revSenti_nrc %>% filter(hiLo != 0)
cat("--- NRC Confusion Matrix ---\n")
table(actual = xx_nrc$hiLo, predicted = xx_nrc$pred_hiLo)
cat("Accuracy:", mean(xx_nrc$hiLo == xx_nrc$pred_hiLo), "\n")

revSenti_nrc %>% group_by(stars) %>% summarise(avgNRC = mean(nrcScore))
```

# Q4: Vader (Valence Aware Dictionary and Sentiment Reasoner)
```{r}
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("r-hf", required = TRUE)

vader_module <- import("vaderSentiment.vaderSentiment")
analyzer <- vader_module$SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()

rrData_clean <- rrData %>% filter(!is.na(text), str_trim(text) != "")

vader_scores <- rrData_clean %>%
  select(review_id, stars) %>%
  mutate(compound = sapply(rrData_clean$text, function(txt) {
    analyzer$polarity_scores(txt)$compound
  }))

vader_scores <- vader_scores %>%
  mutate(
    hiLo      = ifelse(stars <= 2, -1, ifelse(stars >= 4, 1, 0)),
    pred_hiLo = ifelse(compound > 0.05, 1, -1)
  )
```

```{r}
xx_vader <- vader_scores %>% filter(hiLo != 0, abs(compound) > 0.05)
table(actual = xx_vader$hiLo, predicted = xx_vader$pred_hiLo)
cat("Accuracy:", mean(xx_vader$hiLo == xx_vader$pred_hiLo), "\n")
```


# Q5: Predictive Models
```{r}
# Q5: Predictive Models
library(tidytext)
library(textstem)
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)

# ── Tokenization ───────────────────────────────────
rrTokens_q5 <- rrData %>%
  select(review_id, stars, text) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  mutate(word = textstem::lemmatize_words(word)) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(word, "[0-9]"),
         str_length(word) >= 3,
         str_length(word) <= 15)

# Remove rare and very common words
rareWords <- rrTokens_q5 %>% count(word, sort = TRUE) %>% filter(n < 30)
rrTokens_q5 <- anti_join(rrTokens_q5, rareWords, by = "word")

# Count and tf-idf
rrTokens_q5 <- rrTokens_q5 %>%
  group_by(review_id, stars) %>%
  count(word) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(word, review_id, n) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Vocabulary size:", rrTokens_q5 %>% distinct(word) %>% nrow(), "\n")

# ── Build sparse DTM ───────────────────────────────────
fTokens_q5 <- rrTokens_q5 %>%
  filter(stars != 3) %>%
  mutate(hiLo = if_else(stars >= 4, 1, -1))

dtm_sparse <- fTokens_q5 %>% cast_sparse(review_id, word, tf_idf)

hiLoRev <- fTokens_q5 %>% distinct(review_id, hiLo)
hiLo_q5 <- hiLoRev$hiLo[match(rownames(dtm_sparse), hiLoRev$review_id)]

cat("DTM dimensions:", dim(dtm_sparse), "\n")

# ── Train/Test split ─────────────────────
set.seed(17)
n <- nrow(dtm_sparse)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.5 * n)

X_train <- dtm_sparse[train_idx, ]
X_test  <- dtm_sparse[-train_idx, ]
y_train <- hiLo_q5[train_idx]
y_test  <- hiLo_q5[-train_idx]
```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)

set.seed(17)
lasso_model <- cv.glmnet(x = X_train, y = y_train, family = "binomial")

trn_prob_lasso <- predict(lasso_model, newx = X_train, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
tst_prob_lasso <- predict(lasso_model, newx = X_test,  s = "lambda.min", type = "response")

cat("--- Lasso Train ---\n")
table(actual = y_train, predicted = trn_prob_lasso > 0.5)
cat("Train Accuracy:", mean((trn_prob_lasso > 0.5) == (y_train == 1)), "\n")

cat("--- Lasso Test ---\n")
table(actual = y_test, predicted = tst_prob_lasso > 0.5)
cat("Test Accuracy:", mean((tst_prob_lasso > 0.5) == (y_test == 1)), "\n")

roc_lasso_trn <- roc(y_train, as.vector(trn_prob_lasso), levels = c(-1, 1))
roc_lasso_tst <- roc(y_test,  as.vector(tst_prob_lasso), levels = c(-1, 1))
cat("AUC Lasso Train:", auc(roc_lasso_trn), "\n")
cat("AUC Lasso Test:",  auc(roc_lasso_tst), "\n")

best_thr_lasso <- coords(roc_lasso_trn, "best", ret = "threshold", transpose = FALSE)
cat("--- Lasso Optimal Threshold ---\n")
table(actual = y_test, predicted = as.vector(tst_prob_lasso) > unlist(best_thr_lasso))
cat("Optimal Threshold:", unlist(best_thr_lasso), "\n")
cat("Test Accuracy at Optimal Threshold:", mean((as.vector(tst_prob_lasso) > unlist(best_thr_lasso)) == (y_test == 1)), "\n")
```
```{r}
plot.roc(roc_lasso_trn, col = "blue", legacy.axes = TRUE, main = "ROC Curve - Lasso")
plot.roc(roc_lasso_tst, col = "red", add = TRUE)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("Training", "Test"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
```
# Grid Search on mtry and min.node.size
```{r}
library(ranger)

x_train_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(X_train))
x_test_df  <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(X_test))

rf_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry          = c(50, 100, 200),
  min.node.size = c(1, 5, 10)
)

best_rf_acc    <- 0
best_rf_params <- NULL

for (i in 1:nrow(rf_grid)) {
  set.seed(17)
  rf_cv <- ranger(
    x             = x_train_df,
    y             = factor(y_train),
    probability   = TRUE,
    num.trees     = 500,
    mtry          = rf_grid$mtry[i],
    min.node.size = rf_grid$min.node.size[i]
  )
  preds <- predict(rf_cv, data = x_test_df)$predictions[, 2]
  acc   <- mean((preds > 0.5) == (y_test == 1))
  if (acc > best_rf_acc) {
    best_rf_acc    <- acc
    best_rf_params <- rf_grid[i, ]
  }
}

cat("Best RF mtry:", best_rf_params$mtry, "\n")
cat("Best RF min.node.size:", best_rf_params$min.node.size, "\n")

set.seed(17)
rf_model <- ranger(
  x             = x_train_df,
  y             = factor(y_train),
  probability   = TRUE,
  num.trees     = 500,
  mtry          = best_rf_params$mtry,
  min.node.size = best_rf_params$min.node.size
)

rf_pred_trn <- predict(rf_model, data = x_train_df)$predictions
rf_pred_tst <- predict(rf_model, data = x_test_df)$predictions

cat("--- RF Train ---\n")
table(actual = y_train, predicted = rf_pred_trn[, 2] > 0.5)
cat("Train Accuracy:", mean((rf_pred_trn[, 2] > 0.5) == (y_train == 1)), "\n")
cat("--- RF Test ---\n")
table(actual = y_test, predicted = rf_pred_tst[, 2] > 0.5)
cat("Test Accuracy:", mean((rf_pred_tst[, 2] > 0.5) == (y_test == 1)), "\n")

roc_rf_trn <- roc(y_train, rf_pred_trn[, 2], levels = c(-1, 1))
roc_rf_tst <- roc(y_test,  rf_pred_tst[, 2], levels = c(-1, 1))
cat("AUC RF Test:", auc(roc_rf_tst), "\n")

best_thr_rf <- coords(roc_rf_trn, "best", ret = "threshold", transpose = FALSE)
cat("--- RF Optimal Threshold ---\n")
table(actual = y_test, predicted = rf_pred_tst[, 2] > unlist(best_thr_rf))
cat("Optimal Threshold:", unlist(best_thr_rf), "\n")
```

```{r}
n_neg <- sum(y_train == -1)
n_pos <- sum(y_train == 1)

set.seed(17)
rf_model <- ranger(
  x             = x_train_df,
  y             = factor(y_train),
  probability   = TRUE,
  num.trees     = 500,
  mtry          = 50,
  min.node.size = 1,
  class.weights = c(n_pos / n_neg, 1)
)

rf_pred_trn <- predict(rf_model, data = x_train_df)$predictions
rf_pred_tst <- predict(rf_model, data = x_test_df)$predictions

cat("--- RF Train ---\n")
table(actual = y_train, predicted = rf_pred_trn[, 2] > 0.5)
cat("Train Accuracy:", mean((rf_pred_trn[, 2] > 0.5) == (y_train == 1)), "\n")

cat("--- RF Test ---\n")
table(actual = y_test, predicted = rf_pred_tst[, 2] > 0.5)
cat("Test Accuracy:", mean((rf_pred_tst[, 2] > 0.5) == (y_test == 1)), "\n")

roc_rf_trn <- roc(y_train, rf_pred_trn[, 2], levels = c(-1, 1))
roc_rf_tst <- roc(y_test,  rf_pred_tst[, 2], levels = c(-1, 1))
cat("AUC RF Train:", auc(roc_rf_trn), "\n")
cat("AUC RF Test:",  auc(roc_rf_tst), "\n")

best_thr_rf <- coords(roc_rf_trn, "best", ret = "threshold", transpose = FALSE)
cat("--- RF Optimal Threshold ---\n")
table(actual = y_test, predicted = rf_pred_tst[, 2] > unlist(best_thr_rf))
cat("Optimal Threshold:", unlist(best_thr_rf), "\n")
cat("Test Accuracy at Optimal Threshold:", mean((rf_pred_tst[, 2] > unlist(best_thr_rf)) == (y_test == 1)), "\n")

plot.roc(roc_rf_trn, col = "blue", legacy.axes = TRUE, main = "ROC Curve - Random Forest")
plot.roc(roc_rf_tst, col = "red", add = TRUE)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("Training", "Test"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
```


```{r}
library(xgboost)

y_train_bin <- ifelse(y_train == 1, 1, 0)
y_test_bin  <- ifelse(y_test == 1, 1, 0)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train_bin)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test,  label = y_test_bin)

# Grid search over all four parameters
param_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth         = c(3, 6, 9),
  eta               = c(0.1, 0.01, 0.001),
  min_child_weight  = c(1, 10),
  colsample_bytree  = c(0.8, 0.6)
)

xgb_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  set.seed(17)
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = list(
      objective        = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric      = "auc",
      max_depth        = param_grid$max_depth[i],
      eta              = param_grid$eta[i],
      min_child_weight = param_grid$min_child_weight[i],
      colsample_bytree = param_grid$colsample_bytree[i]
    ),
    data                  = dtrain,
    nrounds               = 500,
    nfold                 = 5,
    early_stopping_rounds = 20,
    verbose               = 0
  )
  best_nrounds <- which.max(cv$evaluation_log$test_auc_mean)
  best_auc     <- max(cv$evaluation_log$test_auc_mean)
  xgb_results  <- rbind(xgb_results, data.frame(
    max_depth        = param_grid$max_depth[i],
    eta              = param_grid$eta[i],
    min_child_weight = param_grid$min_child_weight[i],
    colsample_bytree = param_grid$colsample_bytree[i],
    nrounds          = best_nrounds,
    cv_auc           = best_auc
  ))
}

print(xgb_results)
best_xgb <- xgb_results[which.max(xgb_results$cv_auc), ]
cat("Best params: max_depth =", best_xgb$max_depth,
    "| eta =", best_xgb$eta,
    "| min_child_weight =", best_xgb$min_child_weight,
    "| colsample_bytree =", best_xgb$colsample_bytree,
    "| nrounds =", best_xgb$nrounds, "\n")

# Final model with best params
set.seed(17)
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "auc",
    max_depth        = best_xgb$max_depth,
    eta              = best_xgb$eta,
    min_child_weight = best_xgb$min_child_weight,
    colsample_bytree = best_xgb$colsample_bytree
  ),
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_xgb$nrounds,
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_prob_trn <- predict(xgb_model, dtrain)
xgb_prob_tst <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)

cat("--- XGBoost Train ---\n")
table(actual = y_train_bin, predicted = xgb_prob_trn > 0.5)
cat("Train Accuracy:", mean((xgb_prob_trn > 0.5) == y_train_bin), "\n")

cat("--- XGBoost Test ---\n")
table(actual = y_test_bin, predicted = xgb_prob_tst > 0.5)
cat("Test Accuracy:", mean((xgb_prob_tst > 0.5) == y_test_bin), "\n")

roc_xgb_trn <- roc(y_train_bin, xgb_prob_trn)
roc_xgb_tst <- roc(y_test_bin,  xgb_prob_tst)
cat("AUC XGBoost Train:", auc(roc_xgb_trn), "\n")
cat("AUC XGBoost Test:",  auc(roc_xgb_tst), "\n")

best_thr_xgb <- coords(roc_xgb_trn, "best", ret = "threshold", transpose = FALSE)
cat("--- XGBoost Optimal Threshold ---\n")
table(actual = y_test_bin, predicted = xgb_prob_tst > unlist(best_thr_xgb))
cat("Optimal Threshold:", unlist(best_thr_xgb), "\n")
cat("Test Accuracy at Optimal Threshold:", mean((xgb_prob_tst > unlist(best_thr_xgb)) == y_test_bin), "\n")

plot.roc(roc_xgb_trn, col = "blue", legacy.axes = TRUE, main = "ROC Curve - XGBoost")
plot.roc(roc_xgb_tst, col = "red", add = TRUE)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("Training", "Test"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
```
